curatedReviews.text: The freshest Mithai and custom cakes in the DMV area! Their Gulab Jamun and Pineapple cake taste just like the legendary bakery in Pakistan. Highly recommend visiting!
Authentic taste, exceptional quality, and wonderful customer service. The chicken patties and zeera biscuits are a weekend staple in our household.
Stopped by while in Laurel and was blown away by the pastries and mango lassi. Everything is made with love and traditional craftsmanship.
